description: This file manages memory search managers, including caching, loading, fallback mechanisms, and interactions with external modules for memory management, specifically handling QMD backend and index managers.

classes.name: BorrowedMemoryManager
classes.description: A wrapper class that delegates memory search manager operations to an inner manager, used for managing borrowed or cached managers.

classes.name: FallbackMemoryManager
classes.description: A class that provides fallback logic for memory search management, switching between primary and fallback managers based on errors.

methods.name: getMemorySearchManager
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves or creates a memory search manager based on configuration and agent ID, with caching and fallback logic.

methods.name: closeAllMemorySearchManagers
methods.description: Closes all cached memory search managers and associated runtime managers, cleaning up resources.
